definitions.explanation: Suffix indicating a curated selection or anthology of works.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傑作|けっさく}→傑作：00217_kessaku⟧{選|せん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They published a selection of masterpieces.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名|めい}{曲|きょく}→名曲：17476_meikyoku⟧{選|せん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聴|き}いた→聴く：30010_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I listened to a collection of famous pieces.

examples.japanese: ⟦{短編|たんぺん}{小説|しょうせつ}→短編小説：20776_tanpenshousetsu⟧{選|せん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{本屋|ほんや}→本屋：03034_honya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}っている→売る：00906_uru⟧。
examples.english: A short story anthology is being sold at the bookstore.

notes:
{選|せん} is a suffix indicating a curated selection or anthology.

COMPOUNDS:

Books/Literature:
- ⟦{傑作|けっさく}→傑作：00217_kessaku⟧{選|せん}: selection of masterpieces
- ⟦{短編|たんぺん}→短編：04512_tanpen⟧{選|せん}: short story anthology
- {詩|し}{選|せん}: poetry anthology
- ⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧{選|せん}: collection of famous works

Music:
- ⟦{名|めい}{曲|きょく}→名曲：17476_meikyoku⟧{選|せん}: selection of famous songs
- ⟦ベスト→ベスト：04681_besuto⟧{選|せん}: best selection

Photography/Art:
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧{選|せん}: photo selection
- ⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧{選|せん}: selected works

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose, select (verb)
- {選集|せんしゅう}: anthology, collected works
- ⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧: selection, choice
